header.running_head: The Du'aas Rasulullaah ﷺ Made for the Four Khulafaa

blocks.text: The Du'aas Rasulullaah ﷺ Made for the Family of Hadhrat Yaasir (RA), for Hadhrat Abu Salamah (RA) and for Hadhrat Usaama bin Zaid (RA)
Hadhrat Uthmaan bin Affaan (RA) narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ once made du'aa saying, "O Allaah! Forgive the family of Yaasir although you have already forgiven them."[^1]
Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ once made du'aa saying, "O Allaah! Bless Ammaar (RA) (the son of Hadhrat Yaasir (RA))." The Hadith still continues further.[^2]

Hadhrat Ummu Salamah (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ once made du'aa saying, "O Allaah! Forgive Abu Salamah, elevate his rank amongst those close to You and be his successor amongst those (of his family who are) left behind. Forgive us also, O Rabb of the universe and together with expanding his grave, fill it with light as well."[^3]

Hadhrat Usaamah bin Zaid (RA) says, "Rasulullaah ﷺ used to put me on his thigh and then put Hasan bin Ali (RA) on his left thigh. Rasulullaah ﷺ would then hug us and say, "O Allaah! I am compassionate towards the two of them, You also be compassionate towards them."[^4] Another narration states that Rasulullaah ﷺ would say, "O Allaah! I love the two of them, You love them also."[^5]

Hadhrat Usaamah (RA) relates, "When Rasulullaah ﷺ's illness became severe, I returned to Madinah (after camping with the Muslim army in nearby Juruf) and those with me also returned. Rasulullaah ﷺ was unable to speak when I entered (his room) and when he repeatedly placed his hand on me and lifted it, I realised that he was making du'aa for me."[^6]
The Du'aas Rasulullaah ﷺ Made for Hadhrat Amr bin Al Aas (RA), Hadhrat Hakeem bin Hizaam (RA), Hadhrat Jareer (RA) and for the family of Hadhrat Busr (RA)
Hadhrat Jaabir (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ thrice made du'aa saying, "O Allaah! Forgive Amr bin Al Aas because whenever I request him for charity, he always brings it to me."[^7]
